Lira Ashbow — level 1

The woodland archer who reads a trail as readily as a target.

Elf Blade · HP 20/20 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 8 squares · Bulk 10/10.

Languages: Common and Elven. See the @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{language reference}.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.5bee2af81ab3c671.JournalEntryPage.47bee4a5c33159db]{Footfall on the Leaves}: Natural undergrowth does not increase the cost of your voluntary movement. Other difficult terrain, forced movement and occupied-square rules are unchanged. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.271c4e6498cc6e00.JournalEntryPage.5374b74555777a1c]{The Wood Whispers}: In woodland, gain 1 Boon to a consequential roll interpreting living signs of nearby disturbance. The signs can indicate a general direction, not an unseen creature’s exact square; this does not bypass Hidden.

Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3ba04b7b5637ef56.JournalEntryPage.a9a21da370b45af6]{Blade}. Class grants Arms 1 and Athletics 1; 0 duplicate(s) give +0 DP, not higher ranks. Free signature: @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b17ce9b211193c7f.JournalEntryPage.6b4bca7533b85309]{Measured Guard}. Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

Action: Reaction · Attribute: None — no roll

Target / range / shape: Self, before a defense against an adjacent enemy.

Gain 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, you may move up to 2 squares without provoking, whatever the defense result. This does not prevent the attack’s damage or conditions; you must still be able to move.

Duration: The triggering defense and immediate movement.

Equipment / acquisition: None.

Signature limit: Repeatable; normal action economy applies.

Fresh pool: 10 + 0 = 10 DP. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

HP: 12 + ancestry 2 + class 4 + Fortitude 1 + trait 0 + Conditioned Body 1 = 20. Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (0) = 10. Granted Bulk 4 + purchased Bulk 6 = 10, so encumbrance penalty 0. Speed: ancestry 6 + Agility 2 + trait 0 = 8.

Physical resistance: 0. Other resistances: 0. Wounds and death marks: 0. Grit: 2. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

Recipes: none granted or purchased.

At the table

Pinning Shot uses Agility; Read the Quarry offers a Knowledge-based alternative. Take the Measure rewards staying still for the shot. Foraging, climbing and river crossing support the scout role. Measured Guard is an emergency answer when an enemy closes, not an archery signature: this build exposes a real class-identity gap. The bow needs both hands while in use; the knife is stowed then.

Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.

Their equipment and situation requirements still apply.
